/bin/bash -lc "PYTHONPATH=src /app/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, os, time, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from codex_harness.adapters.record_references import artifact_references
from codex_harness.adapters.artifacts import FileArtifacts
from codex_harness.adapters.maintenance import ArtifactMaintenance
from codex_harness.adapters.store import MemoryStore
r='sha256:'+'a'*64
for prefix in ('', 'log [unfinished ', 'log {unfinished '):
 payload=prefix+'{\"candidate\":{},\"image\":\"'+r+'\",\"image\":\"unknown\"}'
 print(json.dumps({'payload':payload,'references':sorted(artifact_references({'stdout':payload}))}))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as d:
 artifacts,store=FileArtifacts(str(Path(d)/'artifacts')),MemoryStore()
 child=artifacts.put('retained child evidence','fixture')['ref']
 payload='log [unfinished '+ '{\"candidate\":{},\"image\":\"'+child+'\",\"image\":\"unknown\"}'
 parent=artifacts.put(json.dumps({'stdout':payload}),'fixture')['ref']
 for path in artifacts.root.glob('*.txt'):
  old=time.time()-14*86400; os.utime(path,(old,old))
 with store.transaction() as tx: tx.put('roots','parent',{'ref':parent})
 result=ArtifactMaintenance(store,artifacts).collect(apply=True)
 print(json.dumps({'collection':result,'child':child,'parent':parent,'child_exists':(artifacts.root/(child[7:]+'.txt')).exists(),'parent_exists':(artifacts.root/(parent[7:]+'.txt')).exists()}))
PY"
